fields.label: Project reference
fields.description: One exact private Project resource identity whose current fields and page body will be revalidated before any change is proposed.

fields.label: Desired project type
fields.description: Optional portable Project type. It is proposed only when the exact current value differs and the current policy and schema both allow it.

fields.label: Desired project status
fields.description: Optional portable Project status. It is proposed only when the exact current value differs and the current policy and schema both allow it.

fields.label: Exact current page text
fields.description: Optional ordered private text regions. Every value must occur exactly once in the freshly observed page body and align with one replacement value.

fields.label: Exact replacement page text
fields.description: Optional ordered private substitutions aligned one-for-one with exact current text. A substitution may lengthen or shorten its selected text; empty deletion, whole-page replacement, old-text-preserving append or prepend, replace-all, and provider-structural operations are unavailable.
